listing.name: Astral Chain (AC-Recomp)
listing.summary: Experimental AArch64 to C++ ahead of time, Wonder-derived native NVN/Vulkan/MoltenVK. AC means ASTRAL CHAIN, not Animal Crossing. Upstream maturity: Only File01 motorcycle chase; save/reload untested. Windows cloud scripted play,8GiB guard can stop long sessions around10min. Linux crash/rendering issues. Acquisition: Mac release build kit/Setup generates locally. Windows source ZIP mentioned but absent latest assets; initial Mac dependency explicit. Platforms: Mac Apple Silicon macOS13+ actual setup DMG/ZIP. Windows x64 AVX2 Vulkan1.3 early source AFTER Mac import. Linux x64 headless early; desktop/audio/pads untested. iOS paused. Original data: Own AstralChain1.0.0 BASE/no update NSP, own keys/titlekeys if needed. Firmware shared fonts optional with Noto fallback but missing icons/CJK. Initial import needs Mac; Windows consumes owned imported files/control receipt. Portcove setup/gameplay untested; no operational integration offered.
